INSERT INTO crm_connections (
            organization_id,
            user_id,
            provider,
            status,
            connected_at,
            oauth_subject,
            crm_tenant_id,
            crm_user_id,
            access_token,
            refresh_token,
            token_type,
            instance_url
         )
         VALUES (
            $1,
            $2,
            'SALESFORCE',
            'CONNECTED',
            now(),
            $3,
            $4,
            $5,
            $6,
            $7,
            'Bearer',
            $8
         )
         RETURNING id AS "id!"
